categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies src/musig.cpp and src/musig.h, which wrap libsecp256k1 cryptographic primitives.
categories.rationale: Prevents a potential process crash by ensuring uninitialized secret nonces are treated as invalid before calling libsecp256k1. The description notes that prior to this change, IsValid() returned true on uninitialized nonces, allowing secp256k1_musig_partial_sign to be reached with uninitialized memory and crash via assertion.
